snippet.title: Game Boy Advance - The Ripping Friends - The World's Most Manly Men! © 2002 THQ - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Suit up for battle with Rip, Chunk, Slab and Crag, the world's most manly men, as they face diabolical villains and hideous monsters that threaten the fate of the earth!
